foods.name: Moussaka
foods.description: Piatto al forno con melanzane, carne speziata, pomodoro e besciamella, stratificato fino a diventare ricco e compatto. È uno dei classici greci più riconoscibili: dolcezza della melanzana, cannella nel ragù e crema superiore danno profondità senza perdere familiarità.
foods.description_en: An oven-baked dish of aubergine, spiced meat, tomato and béchamel, layered until rich and compact. It is one of Greece’s most recognisable classics: aubergine sweetness, cinnamon in the ragout and creamy top layer give depth without losing familiarity.
foods.description_fr: Un gratin au four d'aubergines, viande hachée épicée, tomate et béchamel, cuit en couches alternées et laissé reposer avant d'être servi. Le plat emblématique de la cuisine grecque, riche et parfumé de cannelle et de muscade.

foods.description_en: A creamy meze of fish roe, bread or potato, lemon and olive oil, shared with pita or bread. The best version is savoury but not aggressive, marine and velvety, able to open the meal with a very clear Greek flavour.

neighborhoods.name: Monastiraki / Plaka
neighborhoods.description: Il cuore turistico di Atene, ai piedi dell'Acropoli. Plaka e il quartiere neoclassico piu affascinante, con vicoli fioriti e taverne tradizionali. Monastiraki ospita il famoso mercato delle pulci domenicale.
neighborhoods.description_en: The tourist heart of Athens, at the foot of the Acropolis. Plaka is the most charming neoclassical neighbourhood, with flowered alleys and traditional tavernas. Monastiraki hosts the famous Sunday flea market.
neighborhoods.description_fr: Le cœur touristique d'Athènes, au pied de l'Acropole. Plaka est le quartier néoclassique le plus charmant, avec des ruelles fleuries et des tavernes traditionnelles. Monastiraki accueille le célèbre marché aux puces dominical.

neighborhoods.name: Kolonaki
neighborhoods.description: Il quartiere elegante e borghese di Atene, sul versante del Licabetto. Boutique di lusso, ristoranti raffinati, gallerie d'arte e la migliore selezione di caffe della citta. Ideale per chi cerca comfort e stile.
neighborhoods.description_en: Athens' elegant and upmarket neighbourhood, on the slopes of Lycabettus. Luxury boutiques, refined restaurants, art galleries and the city's best café selection. Ideal for those seeking comfort and style.
neighborhoods.description_fr: Le quartier élégant et bourgeois d'Athènes, sur les pentes du Lycabette. Boutiques de luxe, restaurants raffinés, galeries d'art et la meilleure sélection de cafés de la ville. Idéal pour ceux qui recherchent confort et style.

neighborhoods.name: Psiri / Thissio
neighborhoods.description: Quartieri alternativi trasformati nel cuore della vita notturna ateniese. Street art, bar alla moda, ristoranti creativi e una gioventu locale vivace. Psiri e piu rumoroso, Thissio piu romantico con vista Acropoli.
neighborhoods.description_en: Alternative neighbourhoods transformed into the heart of Athenian nightlife. Street art, trendy bars, creative restaurants and a vibrant local youth scene. Psiri is livelier, Thissio more romantic with Acropolis views.
neighborhoods.description_fr: Quartiers alternatifs transformés en cœur de la vie nocturne athénienne. Street art, bars tendance, restaurants créatifs et une jeunesse locale animée. Psiri est plus festif, Thissio plus romantique avec vue sur l'Acropole.
